Description: A site coordinator in AE requested additional fatigue data for BI-291984 in Pancreatic cancer. No directional opinion was shared. This is country-level input for the Target Development discussion referenced EGFR mutation as a relevant marker. A comparison was drawn against gemcitabine.

A tumor board lead in CA asked a clarifying question about how BI-334219 performs in diabetes-related obesity, without expressing a strong view either way. The exchange was a maintenance setting discussion focused on weight management outcomes.

During a field interaction, an MSL field contact expressed skepticism about BI-291984 in Pancreatic cancer populations and requesting head-to-head comparative data. The treatment-naive population discussion referenced DLL3 expression as a biomarker at the Comprehensive Cancer Center.

An MSL field contact in FR requested additional nausea data for BI-671290 in NAFLD to complete an internal evaluation; no directional opinion was shared. The discussion highlighted needs specific to a patient subgroup. Meeting took place with Alderbrook University Hospital. A recommendation was made to follow up.

A clinical operations lead in CA asked a clarifying question about how BI-847213 performs in myeloma, without expressing a strong view either way. The note concerned an advanced/metastatic setting. A comparison was drawn against tarlatamab.

A site coordinator in US requested additional peripheral neuropathy data for BI-558721 for internal evaluation; no directional opinion was shared. The conversation focused on combination therapy in advanced setting. A comparison was drawn against nivolumab.

A site coordinator in DE raised concerns that BI-702158 data on overall response rate may be lagging behind competitor benchmarks in pancreatic cancer. The KOL recommended more real-world evidence to support adoption.

An investigator in SA expressed enthusiasm about BI-334219 trial design for obesity management. Discussion centered on patient adherence and long-term weight maintenance. Requested additional tolerability data for Gulf region populations.
A hematology KOL at major US cancer center questioned the differentiation of BI-847213 versus existing CAR-T options. Requested clarity on manufacturing timelines and bridging therapy requirements.
A hepatologist in UK advisory board raised concerns about liver enzyme monitoring frequency with BI-671290. Suggested real-world registry data would strengthen the value proposition for NHS adoption.
